rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a person's view and for a doctor's or other expert's formal opinion.

example.english: I want to hear your opinion on this matter.
example.traditional: 我想聽吓你對呢件事嘅意見。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 teng1 haa5 nei5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 ge3 ji3 gin3

rows.note: Use this colloquial choice when emphasizing someone's personal way of looking at an issue.

example.english: I have my own opinion on this matter.
example.traditional: 我對呢件事有自己嘅睇法。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 gin6 si6 jau5 zi6 gei2 ge3 tai2 faat3

rows.meaning: estimate of a person or thing
rows.note: Use this when referring to the assessment or estimation of a person or thing.

example.english: Everyone's opinion of this restaurant is quite positive.
example.traditional: 大家對呢間餐廳嘅評價都幾高。
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 deoi3 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 ping4 gaa3 dou1 gei2 gou1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a judge's formal decision rather than a general expert opinion.

example.english: The judge finally read out the court's opinion.
example.jyutping: faat3 gun1 zung1 jyu1 syun1 duk6 pun3 kyut3
